comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null/empty rules, but the constructs differ in scope. Feature 0 counts only a concrete personal anecdote, meaning the commenter's own experience or that of someone they personally know, and it excludes hypotheticals. Feature 1 counts any specific, concrete illustrative example, including named cases, scenarios or situations, and it explicitly allows non-real-world examples such as hypotheticals. Feature 1 is therefore materially broader. Personal anecdotes are only a subtype of it.
